messages:
Marcus: FYI — Veridian is asking to change renewal to a 9-month term with a price concession (~10%). They want PO path only; DocuSign failed yesterday.
Lina: Can you confirm seat count and plan?
Marcus: 120 seats, Enterprise. Current annual commit $72k. They proposed $54k for 9 months.
Jeff: That's a notable discount. We rarely do 9-months. Any reasoning from the customer?
Marcus: Procurement wants budget alignment with fiscal year; they can't commit to 12 right now.
Sara: Onboarding note: two enablement sessions remain. We can offer concierge sessions during renewal window to add value.
BillingOps: DocuSign timeout recorded 10. Likely SSO redirect issue. We can accept a scanned signed PDF as fallback but it requires manual billing intake and ~48h processing.
Lina: @LegalBot any special amendment language needed for a promotional 9-month term?
LegalBot: OK to proceed. Recommend a clear reversion clause and a statement of acceptable signature methods (DocuSign, signed PDF with authorized signer). Also limit concession timeline.
Jeff: Proposed commercial: 9 months at 85% of annual rate, explicit reversion to standard rates at next renewal, PO required by EOW or default to monthly CC billing until PO received.
Marcus: Can we accept emailed signed PDF if DocuSign glitches again?
BillingOps: Yes. We prefer DocuSign for audit trail but will accept emailed PDF. Note: manual intake will add ~48 hours to invoice creation.
Marcus: Risk flagged: procurement could take >2 weeks. Recommend AE director escalation if PO not confirmed within 72 hours.
Lina: I'll draft the amendment with reversion and accepted signature paths. ETA EOD today.
Jeff: Escalating to procurement lead now (subject: Vendor code + expedited PO for Veridian renewal). :email:
Sara: I'll schedule the two enablement sessions as a concierge kickoff next week to boost renewal momentum.
Marcus: Draft amendment excerpt below:
```
Amendment (draft):
- Term: 9 months beginning 2026-04-01
- Fee: 85% of the annual commit, prorated to cover the 9-month term
- Reversion: Pricing will revert to Redwood's then-published standard rates at the end of this amendment term unless the parties expressly agree in writing to different pricing
- Execution: This amendment may be executed by DocuSign, an emailed signed PDF containing the authorized signer's printed name and title, or an official PO referencing Redwood's agreement
```
LegalBot: Wording fine; consider adding a PO issuance deadline and an explicit acceptance clause for the PDF signature format.
Marcus: Updated with PO deadline clause (PO issued by 2026-03-27) and clarification on PDF signer block. Uploaded version v2.
BillingOps: Ready to process either path. If we receive PDF, please include a cover email that confirms signer name and title to expedite manual intake.
Jeff: Procurement just replied: vendor code approved; they expect PO by Friday 12:00pm.
Marcus: Great. Keeping thread open until PO hits. Will escalate if missed. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
